name: CleanSheet 2
storyline:
Your journey begins in the Beginners League, where you must first pledge your allegiance to one of three elite virtual clubs: the fast and fluid Waveport City led by Coach Penny, the disciplined Stanton United guided by Coach Albus, or the gritty Forgehill Rovers mentored by Coach Gunnar.

On the training ground, your chosen coach will set dynamic challenges based on your performance in exercises like the new 'Pick-A-Save' drill. Completing these tasks earns you Loot Balls to unlock rare and legendary reward items, such as new gloves.

As your skills sharpen, CleanSheet 2’s revamped instant-promotion system allows you to bypass the old monthly wait and advance immediately through five competitive divisions once you meet the criteria.

As you progress, your environment evolves from a basic pitch to massive stadium upgrades. If your playstyle changes along the way, you can easily request a monthly club transfer to find a better fit.

Every save and completed challenge builds your legacy as you fight to reach the top-tier Legends League and ultimately unlock the Platinum Trophy.
summary: From the creators of CleanSheet Football, CleanSheet 2 delivers the definitive goalkeeping experience on PlayStationVR2. Step between the posts with faster gameplay, advanced training systems, and authentic match situations designed to test your reactions, positioning, and composure under pressure.
